item.title: Notes of a Surviving Lemming
item.description: Last autumn I lost my VPN. A story about the patterns that kill services, the arms race between regulators and protocols — and why all of it is ultimately about people.

item.title: Utopia
item.description: Why a private network is first and foremost a social structure, how it grows from the bottom up, and why freedom of communication should be a norm — not a privilege.
